334: pub tracked struct ContextGhost<DT: Dispatch> {
335:     pub batch_perms: Option<PointsTo<PendingOperation<DT>>>,
336: 
337:     pub slots: FlatCombiner::slots,
338: 
339:     pub update: Option<UnboundedLog::local_updates<DT>>
340: }
341: 
342: pub open spec fn inv(&self, v: u64, tid: nat, cell: PCell<PendingOperation<DT>>, fc: FlatCombiner::Instance, inst: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>) -> bool {
343:     predicate {
344:         &&& self.slots.key() == tid
345:         &&& self.slots.instance_id() == fc.id()
346: 
347:         &&& ((v == 0) || (v == 1))
348:         &&& (v == 0 ==> self.slots.value().is_Empty() || self.slots.value().is_Response())
349:         &&& (v == 1 ==> self.slots.value().is_Request() || self.slots.value().is_InProgress())
350: 
351:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_Empty() ==> {
352:             &&& self.update.is_none()
353:             &&& self.batch_perms.is_none()
354:         })
355: 
356:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_Request() ==> {
357:             &&& self.update matches Some(update)
358:             &&& update.value().is_Init()
359:             &&& update.key() == self.slots.value().get_ReqId()
360:             &&& update.instance_id() == inst.id()
361: 
362:             &&& self.batch_perms matches Some(batch_perms)
363:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().is_init()
364:             &&& batch_perms@.pcell == cell.id()
365:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().value().op == update.value().get_Init_op()
366:         })
367: 
368:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_InProgress() ==> {
369:             &&& self.update.is_none()
370:             &&& self.batch_perms.is_none()
371:         })
372: 
373:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_Response() ==> {
374:             &&& self.update matches Some(update)
375:             &&& update.value().is_Done()
376:             &&& update.key() == self.slots.value().get_ReqId()
377:             &&& update.instance_id() == inst.id()
378: 
379:             &&& self.batch_perms matches Some(batch_perms)
380:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().is_init()
381:             &&& batch_perms@.pcell == cell.id()
382:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().value().resp matches Some(resp)
383:             &&& resp == update.value().get_Done_ret()
384:         })
385:     }
386: }
387: }

390: pub tracked struct FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT: Dispatch> {

397: impl<DT: Dispatch> FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT> {
398:     pub open spec fn enqueue_op_pre(
399:         &self,
400:         tid: nat,
401:         op: DT::WriteOperation,
402:         batch_cell: CellId,
403:         fc_inst: FlatCombiner::Instance,
404:         inst: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>,
405:     ) -> bool {
406:         &&& self.local_updates matches Some(local_updates)
407:         &&& local_updates.instance_id() == inst.id()
408:         &&& local_updates.value().is_Init()
409:         &&& local_updates.value().get_Init_op() == op
410:         &&& self.batch_perms matches Some(batch_perms)
411:         &&& batch_perms@.pcell == self.cell_id
412:         &&& self.cell_id == batch_cell
413:         &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().is_uninit()
414:         &&& self.fc_clients.instance_id() == fc_inst.id()
415:         &&& self.fc_clients.key() == tid
416:         &&& self.fc_clients.value().is_Idle()
417:     }
418: 
419:     pub open spec fn enqueue_op_post(&self, pre: FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT>) -> bool
420:         recommends
421:             pre.local_updates.is_some(),
422:     {
423:         &&& self.fc_clients.value().is_Waiting()
424:         &&& self.fc_clients.value().get_Waiting_0() == pre.local_updates.unwrap().key()
425:         &&& self.fc_clients.instance_id() == pre.fc_clients.instance_id()
426:         &&& self.fc_clients.key() == pre.fc_clients.key()
427:         &&& self.cell_id == pre.cell_id
428:         &&& self.batch_perms.is_none()
429:         &&& self.local_updates.is_none()
430:     }
431: 
432:     pub open spec fn dequeue_resp_pre(
433:         &self,
434:         batch_cell: CellId,
435:         tid: nat,
436:         fc_inst: FlatCombiner::Instance,
437:     ) -> bool {
438:         &&& self.fc_clients.key() == tid
439:         &&& self.fc_clients.instance_id() == fc_inst.id()
440:         &&& self.fc_clients.value().is_Waiting()
441:         &&& self.batch_perms.is_none()
442:         &&& self.local_updates.is_none()
443:         &&& self.cell_id == batch_cell
444:     }
445: 
446:     pub open spec fn dequeue_resp_post(
447:         &self,
448:         pre: FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT>,
449:         ret: Option<DT::Response>,
450:         inst: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>,
451:     ) -> bool {
452:         &&& ret matches Some(ret) ==> {
453:             &&& self.cell_id == pre.cell_id
454:             &&& self.batch_perms matches Some(batch_perms)
455:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().is_uninit()
456:             &&& batch_perms@.pcell == self.cell_id
457:             &&& self.local_updates matches Some(local_updates)
458:             &&& local_updates.instance_id() == inst.id()
459:             &&& local_updates.value().is_Done()
460:             &&& local_updates.key() == pre.fc_clients.value().get_Waiting_0()
461:             &&& local_updates.value().get_Done_ret() == ret
462:             &&& self.fc_clients.instance_id() == pre.fc_clients.instance_id()
463:             &&& self.fc_clients.key() == pre.fc_clients.key()
464:             &&& self.fc_clients.value().is_Idle()
465:         }
466:         &&& ret.is_none() ==> {
467:             &&& self == pre
468:         }
469:     }
470: }

578:         &&& self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.unbounded_log_instance() == self.unbounded_log_instance

581:     invariant on version_upper_bound with (unbounded_log_instance) specifically (self.version_upper_bound.0) is (v: u64, g: UnboundedLog::version_upper_bound<DT>) {
582:         &&& g.instance_id() == unbounded_log_instance@.id()

593:     invariant on tail with (cyclic_buffer_instance, unbounded_log_instance) specifically (self.tail.0) is (v: u64, g: (UnboundedLog::tail<DT>, CyclicBuffer::tail<DT>)) {
594:         &&& g.0.instance_id() == unbounded_log_instance@.id()
595:         &&& g.0.value() == v
596:         &&& g.1.instance_id() == cyclic_buffer_instance@.id()

607:         &&& g.0.instance_id() == unbounded_log_instance@.id()

629:             res.0.wf(),

638:         let tracked ul_replicas: Map<NodeId, UnboundedLog::replicas<DT>>;
639:         let tracked mut ul_local_versions: Map<NodeId, UnboundedLog::local_versions<DT>>;
640:         let tracked ul_version_upper_bound: UnboundedLog::version_upper_bound<DT>;
641:         let tracked ul_combiner: Map<NodeId, UnboundedLog::combiner<DT>>;
642:         proof {
643:             let tracked (
644:                 Tracked(unbounded_log_instance0),  
645:                 Tracked(ul_log0),  
646:                 Tracked(ul_tail0),  
647:                 Tracked(ul_replicas0),  
648:                 Tracked(ul_local_versions0),  
649:                 Tracked(ul_version_upper_bound0),  
650:                 _,  
651:                 _,  
652:                 Tracked(ul_combiner0),

654:             unbounded_log_instance = unbounded_log_instance0;
655:             ul_tail = ul_tail0;
656:             ul_replicas = ul_replicas0.into_map();
657:             ul_local_versions = ul_local_versions0.into_map();

659:             ul_combiner = ul_combiner0.into_map();
660:         }
661:         let ghost mut logical_log_idx;
662:         proof {
663:             logical_log_idx = -log_size as int;
664:         }
665:         let mut slog_entries: Vec<Option<PCell<Option<ConcreteLogEntry<DT>>>>> = Vec::with_capacity(
666:             log_size,
667:         );
668:         let ghost mut cell_ids: Seq<CellId> = Seq::empty();
669:         let tracked mut contents: Map<LogicalLogIdx, StoredType<DT>> = Map::tracked_empty();
670:         let mut log_idx = 0;

673:                 0 <= log_idx <= log_size,

682:                     #[trigger] slog_entries[i]).unwrap().id(),

684:                 forall|i| #[trigger]

687:                         i,
688:                         cell_ids[log_entry_idx(i, log_size as nat) as int],
689:                         unbounded_log_instance,
690:                     ),

695:                 cell_ids = cell_ids.push(pcell.id());

711:         let tracked cyclic_buffer_instance: CyclicBuffer::Instance<DT>;
712:         let tracked cb_head: CyclicBuffer::head<DT>;
713:         let tracked cb_tail: CyclicBuffer::tail<DT>;
714:         let tracked mut cb_local_versions: Map<NodeId, CyclicBuffer::local_versions<DT>>;
715:         let tracked mut cb_alive_bits: Map<LogIdx, CyclicBuffer::alive_bits<DT>>;
716:         let tracked cb_combiners: Map<NodeId, CyclicBuffer::combiner<DT>>;
717:         proof {
718:             let tracked (
719:                 Tracked(cyclic_buffer_instance0),  
720:                 Tracked(cb_head0),  
721:                 Tracked(cb_tail0),  
722:                 Tracked(cb_local_versions0),  
723:                 Tracked(cb_alive_bits0),  
724:                 Tracked(cb_combiner0),

727:                 num_replicas as nat,

731:                 contents,
732:             );
733:             cyclic_buffer_instance = cyclic_buffer_instance0;
734:             cb_head = cb_head0;
735:             cb_tail = cb_tail0;
736:             cb_local_versions = cb_local_versions0.into_map();

741:         let mut log_idx = 0;
742:         while log_idx < log_size
743:             invariant
744:                 0 <= log_idx <= log_size,
745:                 slog_entries.len() == log_size,
746:                 slog.len() == log_idx,
747:                 cell_ids.len() == log_size,
748:                 forall|i|
749:                     #![trigger slog[i]]

751:                         &&& slog[i].wf(i as nat, cyclic_buffer_instance)
752:                         &&& slog[i].log_entry.id() == (#[trigger] cell_ids[i])

755:                 forall|i|
756:                     #![trigger cb_alive_bits[i]]
757:                     log_idx <= i < log_size ==> {
758:                         &&& cb_alive_bits[i].key() == i
759:                         &&& cb_alive_bits[i].value() == false

781:                 log_entry: log_entry,
782:                 alive: AtomicBool::new(
783:                     Ghost((Ghost(log_idx as nat), cb_inst)),

786:                 ),
787:                 cyclic_buffer_idx: Ghost(log_idx as nat),
788:                 cyclic_buffer_instance: Tracked(cyclic_buffer_instance.clone()),

793:         let ul_inst = Tracked(unbounded_log_instance.clone());
794:         let version_upper_bound = CachePadded(

796:         );
797:         let cb_inst = Tracked(cyclic_buffer_instance.clone());
798:         let head = CachePadded(AtomicU64::new(Ghost(cb_inst), 0, Tracked(cb_head)));
799:         let cb_inst = Tracked(cyclic_buffer_instance.clone());
800:         let ul_inst = Tracked(unbounded_log_instance.clone());
801:         let tail = CachePadded(
802:             AtomicU64::new(Ghost((cb_inst, ul_inst)), 0, Tracked((ul_tail, cb_tail))),

804:         let mut local_versions: Vec<
805:             CachePadded<
806:                 AtomicU64<
807:                     (Tracked<UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>>, Tracked<CyclicBuffer::Instance<DT>>, int),
808:                     (UnboundedLog::local_versions<DT>, CyclicBuffer::local_versions<DT>),

810:                 >,
811:             >,

819:                 forall|i| nid <= i < num_replicas ==> cb_local_versions.contains_key(i),

824:                         &&& cb_local_versions[i].key() == i

831:                         &&& ul_local_versions[i].key() == i
832:                         &&& ul_local_versions[i].value() == 0

839:                         &&& local_versions[i].0.constant().1 == cyclic_buffer_instance
840:                         &&& local_versions[i].0.constant().2 == i

846:             let tracked cb_version;

866:         let mut replica_tokens: Vec<ReplicaToken> = Vec::with_capacity(num_replicas);

944:     pub(crate) fn get_version_upper_bound(
945:         &self,
946:         local_reads: Tracked<UnboundedLog::local_reads<DT>>,
947:     ) -> (ret: (u64, Tracked<UnboundedLog::local_reads<DT>>))
948:         requires
949:             self.wf(),
950:             local_reads@.instance_id() == self.unbounded_log_instance@.id(),
951:             local_reads@.value().is_Init(),
952:         ensures
953:             ret.1@.value().is_VersionUpperBound(),
954:             ret.1@.value().get_VersionUpperBound_version_upper_bound() == ret.0 as nat,
955:             ret.1@.value().get_VersionUpperBound_op() == local_reads@.value().get_Init_op(),
956:             ret.1@.instance_id() == self.unbounded_log_instance@.id(),
957:             ret.1@.key() == local_reads@.key(),
958:     {
959:         let tracked local_reads = local_reads.get();
960:         let ghost rid = local_reads.key();
961:         let tracked new_local_reads_g: UnboundedLog::local_reads<DT>;
962:         let res =
963:             atomic_with_ghost!(
964:             &self.version_upper_bound.0 => load();
965:             returning res;
966:             ghost g => {
967:                 new_local_reads_g = self.unbounded_log_instance.borrow()
968:                                             .readonly_version_upper_bound(rid, &g, local_reads);
969:             }
970:         );
971:         (res, Tracked(new_local_reads_g))
972:     }

1010:             }

1039:     pub fn append(
1040:         &self,
1041:         replica_token: &ReplicaToken,
1042:         operations: &Vec<DT::WriteOperation>,
1043:         responses: &mut Vec<DT::Response>,
1044:         actual_replica: &mut DT,
1045:         ghost_data: Tracked<NrLogAppendExecDataGhost<DT>>,
1046:     ) -> (result: Tracked<NrLogAppendExecDataGhost<DT>>)
1047:         requires
1048:             self.wf(),
1049:             replica_token@ < self.local_versions.len(),
1050:             old(responses).len() == 0,
1051:             ghost_data@.append_pre(
1052:                 replica_token@,
1053:                 old(actual_replica).view(),
1054:                 operations@,
1055:                 self.unbounded_log_instance@,
1056:                 self.cyclic_buffer_instance@,
1057:             ),
1058:             operations.len() <= MAX_REQUESTS,

1060:             result@.append_post(
1061:                 ghost_data@,
1062:                 replica_token@,
1063:                 final(actual_replica).view(),
1064:                 operations@,
1065:                 final(responses)@,
1066:                 self.unbounded_log_instance@,
1067:                 self.cyclic_buffer_instance@,
1068:             ),
1069:     {
1070:         let tracked mut ghost_data_new = ghost_data.get();
1071:         let nid = replica_token.id() as usize;
1072:         let nops = operations.len();
1073:         let mut iteration = 1;
1074:         let mut waitgc = 1;
1075:         loop
1076:             invariant
1077:                 self.wf(),
1078:                 0 <= waitgc <= WARN_THRESHOLD,
1079:                 0 <= iteration <= WARN_THRESHOLD,
1080:                 responses.len() == 0,
1081:                 replica_token@ < self.local_versions.len(),
1082:                 nid == replica_token@,
1083:                 nops == operations.len(),
1084:                 nops <= MAX_REQUESTS,
1085:                 ghost_data_new.cb_combiner@.value() == ghost_data@.cb_combiner@.value(),
1086:                 ghost_data_new.request_ids@ == ghost_data@.request_ids@,
1087:                 ghost_data_new.append_pre(
1088:                     replica_token@,
1089:                     actual_replica.view(),
1090:                     operations@,
1091:                     self.unbounded_log_instance@,
1092:                     self.cyclic_buffer_instance@,
1093:                 ),
1094:         {
1095:             let tracked NrLogAppendExecDataGhost {
1096:                 local_updates,
1097:                 ghost_replica,
1098:                 combiner,
1099:                 cb_combiner,
